description: This file defines the 'Enrollment' entity class for a learning management system backend, representing student or instructor enrollment data in courses, including fields for role, timestamps, and associated IDs.

classes.name: Enrollment
classes.description: Entity class representing course enrollment details, including role and timestamps.

classes.name: Enrollment.RoleInCourse
classes.description: Enumeration defining possible roles within a course, such as STUDENT and INSTRUCTOR.

methods.name: Enrollment()
methods.description: Protected default constructor, used by JPA.

methods.name: Enrollment(Long, Long, RoleInCourse)
methods.description: Constructor to initialize a new Enrollment instance with course ID, user ID, and role.

methods.name: getId()
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of this enrollment record.

methods.name: getRoleInCourse()
methods.description: Returns the role of the user in the course (student or instructor).

methods.name: getCreatedAt()
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the enrollment was created.
